Name: (CP) Vanillaish Sabrina (Genderbend Sebastian)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbent local emo girl Sabrina, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Currently there is no matching sprites yet, and since I got half of the portrait done, I'll work on the matching sprites for them now. 

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Sabrina into your mod folder.
﻿- In configuration, choose the variation: Normal or Accessories or type them in config.json file under the SebastianAccessories.

[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Sebastian portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Sebastian changes in those mod.

[b]PERMISSIONS:[/b] As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

[b]CREDITS:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] for inspiration.
